## Biography

"You can fuel a ship with anything that burns. The question is whether you want to arrive."

Nadya Holdstock is a fuel specialist who joined the Distant Worlds 3 expedition with practical knowledge and zero tolerance for shortcuts. When Commander LilacLight found the derelict prototype, Holdstock was among the first to examine the residue — nanite compounds, strange filaments, crew remains partially consumed by something the logs could not name. She connected the find to a broader pattern of ancient technology resurfacing in modern space. Not academically. Practically. The kind of knowledge that comes from handling dangerous materials daily and learning which ones bite.

Holdstock also worked with Doctor Gery during the Rainbow's End quarantine, helping establish protocols for material that had no business existing in the 3310s. She never wrote papers about it. Just kept the tanks full and the crew alive.
